title: outline for inputs
body: All our inputs disable the `outline`, but they have no other clear visual implementation, which will make that keyboard users don't know where on the page they are.

comments.body: The background-color changes, but not much... People with impaired vision might not see the change. I'll remove that.
It should probably be something _like_ the outline, but made with borders or shadows
This is still relevant today as we're considering accessibility checks and new theming. Keeping it open for the migration.
